SCOPE. FP rows whose reason rested on callers, in non-static functions of files wpa_supplicant links under some configuration (the union of its Makefile OBJS under every ifdef). This batch covers 134 such rows. Held back and NOT changed here: 16 whose key realworld run 274 no longer emits (pending a ruling on non-emitted keys), 0 inside an #ifdef HOSTAPD / hostapd-only CONFIG_* arm that the wpa_supplicant build cannot compile.

METHOD. One read-only agent read every row at source at the pinned commit, judging the value the run-274 message names, and decided whether any basis inside the function or its callees holds (a dominating test, a NULL-tolerant callee, a language guarantee, a local value's own flow, or the site not being a violation site). A fresh-context refuter re-read a sample (30 random TP flips of the emitted rows (no emitted FP keeps or non-high calls); 30/30 upheld.).

RESULT. 118 FP -> TP here (API00-C 118): the only basis was the caller set. 0 stay FP with the reason restated to its local basis.

Mechanics: in-place edits keep each key; each original batch takes a row_count decrement and a superseded_rows record. Counting basis: distinct (project, commit, file, line, rule) keys. No precision claim is made here.
